title: Advanced Connectors and Word Formation
summary: Using indem, ohne ... zu, anstatt ... zu, als ob, and selected B1 word formation patterns.
whyItMatters: These connectors express method, omitted action, alternatives, and apparent but uncertain reality; word formation helps decode unfamiliar formal vocabulary.

mentalModel.title: Choose the relationship first
mentalModel.content: Decide whether the clause expresses how, without doing, instead of doing, or an unreal appearance.

mentalModel.title: Build words from transparent parts
mentalModel.content: Use prefixes and suffixes to infer category and meaning while checking context.

ruleBlocks.title: Use indem for method
ruleBlocks.content: The subordinate clause explains how the main result is achieved and ends with the finite verb.

ruleBlocks.title: Use ohne ... zu for omitted same-subject action
ruleBlocks.content: Use a finite 'ohne dass' clause when the subjects differ.

ruleBlocks.title: Use anstatt ... zu for an alternative action
ruleBlocks.content: The understood subject normally matches the main-clause subject.

ruleBlocks.title: Use als ob for unreal appearance
ruleBlocks.content: Use verb-final order, often with Konjunktiv II.

tables.title: Advanced Connector Map
rows: Man prüft das Bild, indem man die Quelle sucht.
Er teilte den Beitrag, ohne ihn zu prüfen.
Sie recherchierte, anstatt sofort zu reagieren.
Es wirkt, als ob die Zahl erfunden wäre.

sentenceStructure: Infinitive constructions require a shared understood subject.
Separate expanded infinitive groups with commas.
Word formation gives clues, not guaranteed definitions.

comparisons.summary: Media verification supplies authentic method and omission contexts.
Negotiation uses these connectors to explain process and counterproductive alternatives.

examples.de: Man stärkt Medienkompetenz, indem man Quellen regelmäßig vergleicht.
examples.en: Media literacy is strengthened by regularly comparing sources.

examples.de: Er veröffentlichte die Meldung, ohne die Zahlen zu überprüfen.
examples.en: He published the report without checking the figures.

examples.de: Anstatt den Fehler zu verstecken, korrigierte die Redaktion ihn offen.
examples.en: Instead of hiding the error, the editorial team corrected it openly.

examples.de: Der Text klingt, als ob er von einer Fachperson geschrieben worden wäre.
examples.en: The text sounds as if it had been written by an expert.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use ohne ... zu with different subjects.
commonMistakes.reason: The infinitive construction normally shares its subject.

commonMistakes.correct: Use indem for method; use sodass for result.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume every derived word equals the sum of its parts exactly.
commonMistakes.correct: Use morphology as a clue and confirm from context.

tips: Label the logical relationship before choosing a connector.
Rewrite finite clauses as infinitive groups only when subjects match.
Build word families around common stems.
